prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in steps and introducing adoption new flows consistently hurt performance across tests.
Adoption new screens and sign-in hints proved helpful, driving multiple winning tests.
Finish layouts consistently degraded performance, resulting in guardrail rollbacks.
Home wait-info, adoption copy, finish hints, and finish notifications mostly showed no clear effect across repeated tests.
Evidence remains thin or mixed for single-test categories or kinds with contradictory results like adoption redesigns.
Predictions were systematically too optimistic for failing tests and underestimated returns on winning tests.

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_screen] upload_photos_photo_quality_guide_new_screen: Adds a dedicated photo quality guide screen before photo upload showing visual criteria and checklist for clear pet photos. (why: 3 support emails reported that custom pet creation fails or results look wrong. A photo guidance screen helps users provide better input photos.)
1: [sign_in, hint] sign_in_account_switch_safety_hint: Displays a clear hint reminding returning users to log into their original account to preserve existing pets. (why: 8 support emails cited missing or reset pets after signing back in, indicating account switching or accidental secondary account creation.)
2: [adoption, new_screen] pick_friend_pet_care_preview_new_screen: Inserts a screen showcasing daily desktop pet interactions and care actions before completing adoption. (why: Lessons show adoption new screens perform well, and 3 support emails reported post-onboarding confusion on how to interact with pets.)
3: [sign_in, notification] sign_in_session_status_notification: Shows an interactive ready notification during authentication setup to signal active connection progress. (why: 2 support emails reported sign-in screen stalling or failing to open properly, leading to sign-in drop-off.)
4: [adoption, redesign] upload_photos_two_column_redesign: Redesigns the photo upload screen into a two-column layout separating instructions from the photo upload portal. (why: Adoption stage has a mean time of 1017s; structured two-column layout makes photo uploading faster and reduces errors.)
5: [choose_path, copy] choose_path_clear_journey_copy: Updates body text on choose_path screen to explicitly contrast standard pre-made pets versus custom photo creation. (why: Choose path stage has a high mean duration of 514s despite low median (8s), showing long-tail user hesitation.)
6: [home, wait_info] waiting_desktop_setup_progress_wait_info: Adds active progress status indicators and time estimates to the desktop preparation wait screen. (why: Home wait step has a high median time of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing drop-off during background initialization.)
7: [finish, copy] home_intro_desktop_interaction_guide_copy: Replaces finish copy with explicit controls instructions on clicking, dragging, and hiding the desktop pet. (why: Finish stage drops to 64.8% completion, and 3 support emails noted confusion over controlling and hiding the desktop pet.)
8: [adoption, new_flow] pick_friend_interactive_preview_new_flow: Adds an interactive stage screen where users can test pet animations and drags before confirming adoption. (why: Adoption completion is 74.5%; letting users preview desktop responsiveness upfront boosts adoption confidence.)
9: [choose_path, hint] story_onboarding_purpose_hint: Adds a hint on the story screen highlighting that onboarding takes under two minutes. (why: Overall onboarding conversion is only 26.4%; establishing short time commitment at the start reduces early drop-off.)
